d: Discover the next trend. Build the next brand. Create products people want to wear.
What if you could spot a market gap today and help turn it into the next big product tomorrow?

At Boutiqaat, we’re looking for a Brand Specialist to help build, grow, and evolve Boutiqaat-owned and private-label brands, product collections, and celebrity collaborations across Contact Lenses & Eyewear. This isn’t just a brand management role. It’s a role for someone who is curious about consumers, obsessed with trends, commercially minded, and excited by the journey from “What if?” to a product sitting on the shelf and ultimately in the hands of a customer. You’ll work across the entire brand and product lifecycle: research, ideas, concepts, sourcing, product development, manufacturing, launch, performance, and what comes next.
q: Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Marketing, International Business, Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
1–3 years of relevant experience in brand management, product development, sourcing, market research, private-label development, retail, or a related field is preferred.
Experience in brand management, product research, market analysis, sourcing, supplier coordination, or product development is an advantage — but not essential.
Strong fresh graduates are welcome to apply if they demonstrate analytical ability, creativity, commercial thinking, curiosity, ownership, and a genuine interest in brands and products.
Experience or exposure to Contact Lenses & Eyewear, fashion, consumer products, or private-label development is an advantage.
Willingness to travel internationally when required for sourcing, exhibitions, supplier meetings, manufacturer engagement, and product development.
Can look at data, trends, and customer insights and ask: “So, what’s the opportunity?”
Can turn a market gap or consumer insight into a brand idea, product concept, collection, or new opportunity.
Comfortable researching markets, analyzing sales and competitor information, and turning data into decisions.
Collaborate work confidently with Account Managers, internal teams, manufacturers, suppliers, and external partners and keep everyone moving in the same direction
Proactive who don’t wait for someone to tell you what needs to happen. You spot the next step, follow up, solve problems, and take ownership.
Detail-Oriented who can keep track of specifications, samples, costing, MOQ, packaging, quality, production, timelines, and approvals without losing sight of the bigger picture.
Familiarity with product tracking, sales analysis, reporting, or business systems is an advantage.
Fluent in English; Arabic is an advantage.

At Boutiqaat, you won’t just join a company you’ll join a movement redefining e-commerce beauty and lifestyle retail. Here, every day offers new challenges, learning opportunities, and a chance to help build a smarter, more efficient operation from the ground up.
Kickstart your career with hands-on experience, expert mentorship, and real impact. Apply now and be part of something exciting!

Identify market gaps, customer needs, emerging trends, and commercial opportunities.

Help transform approved concepts into commercially relevant product ranges.
Coordinate product concepts from the first idea and specifications through sampling, revisions, final approval, production, and launch.
Work with manufacturers and internal teams to define product specifications, designs, materials, quality, packaging, pricing, and other requirements.
Continuously challenge and improve existing products, collections, and concepts based on customer feedback, market trends, and performance.

Evaluate partners based on capabilities, quality, pricing, capacity, product requirements, and development needs.
Coordinate specifications, samples, modifications, costing, MOQs, packaging, quality requirements, lead times, and production.

Understand celebrity audiences and connect their interests and preferences with market opportunities.
Coordinate everything from concepts and samples to specifications, packaging, costing, approvals, production, and launch.
Track collaboration milestones and ensure projects move forward smoothly.
Monitor how celebrity collections perform and identify opportunities for new products, extensions, improvements, and future collections.
Monitor sales, sell-through, stock levels, SKU performance, and overall brand performance.
Analyze sales data, customer feedback, competitor activity, market trends, and product performance.
Benchmark local and international competitors to identify opportunities in pricing, assortment, positioning, and product development.
Prepare brand, product, market, and sales analysis and turn insights into clear recommendations.
Identify actions that can improve performance, product mix, replenishment, assortment, and future development.
Support commercial targets and take ownership of agreed actions that move brands forward.
Keep track of key products and brand lifecycle milestones and ensure everyone is aligned on priorities and timelines.

d: Do you turn commercial data into decisions that drive growth a business ? As a Commercial Performance Analyst, you’ll help the team improve listing conversion, invest promotional budgets effectively and uncover opportunities across Food, Groceries and Non-Food. Your role goes beyond reporting: you’ll translate insights into clear actions and track whether they deliver results.

Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills
A solid understanding of conversion funnels, promotional economics, customer retention and commercial performance metrics.
Strong analytical judgment: you can explain why performance changed and recommend what the business should do next.
Clear communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to turn complex analysis into practical recommendations.
Experience supporting a new market launch or working in Oman or other GCC markets.
Knowledge of restaurant, grocery or non-food marketplace operations.
Experience with experimentation, forecasting, and/or automated reporting.

d: Lucidya is a leading AI-powered Customer Experience Management (CXM) platform in the MENA region, enabling enterprises to understand, engage, and serve their customers across digital channels at scale.

As we continue to scale our platform and move toward IPO-scale engineering, we are looking for a Frontend Software Engineer who is passionate about building high-quality user experiences, learning quickly, and using modern engineering practices — including AI — to deliver better software faster.

This role is ideal for an engineer with 0–2 years of professional experience who has a solid foundation in frontend development and wants to grow in an environment where ownership, speed, quality, collaboration, and continuous improvement matter.

We don't measure impact by how many lines of code you write. We care about your ability to understand problems, build maintainable solutions, collaborate effectively, and continuously improve the way you work.
Please note that this position is strictly open to Saudi nationals only. Applications from non-Saudi nationals will not be considered and will be disqualified from the recruitment process.
q: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a closely related field.
0–2 years of professional frontend development experience.
Hands-on experience building applications with React .
Good understanding of TypeScript and type-safe development.
Good understanding of React fundamentals, including components, hooks, state management, rendering, and component lifecycle.
Experience integrating frontend applications with APIs and handling asynchronous data.
Familiarity with React Query / TanStack Query and Redux / Redux Toolkit .
Understanding of frontend testing and experience with tools such as Jest and Playwright .
Familiarity with real-time frontend architectures using WebSockets / Socket.IO .
Basic understanding of message queues and event-driven systems , especially RabbitMQ .
Understanding of common real-time challenges such as reconnection, duplicate events, stale data, race conditions, and keeping UI state synchronized.
Solid understanding of HTML, CSS, responsive design, and browser fundamentals .
Familiarity with Git and collaborative development workflows.
Ability to debug problems rather than only work around them.
Ability to write clean, readable, and maintainable code.
Practical experience using AI tools to improve software engineering productivity .
Strong willingness to learn and continuously improve.
This Role Is a Strong Fit If You...
Can take a feature from requirement to production instead of stopping when the code simply "works."
Care about both speed and quality — you don't believe one has to come at the expense of the other.
Use AI to multiply your productivity while still understanding and owning every solution you ship.
Don't blindly copy AI-generated code — you question it, review it, test it, and improve it.
Try to understand why something works, not only how to make it work.
Investigate bugs and edge cases instead of immediately passing them to someone else.
Treat testing as part of development rather than an optional final step.
Care about code readability, scalability, and maintainability.
Can receive code-review feedback and use it to improve.
Communicate early when you are blocked.
Enjoy collaborating and sharing knowledge with other engineers.
Are curious about the product, not just the ticket assigned to you.
Look for opportunities to improve existing code and engineering processes.
Have a strong sense of ownership and don't need constant follow-up to get things done.
Want to become a significantly stronger engineer over the next few years.
Within your first months at Lucidya, we expect you to
Understand the frontend codebase, architecture, and development workflow.
Deliver production features with increasing independence.
Write clean and maintainable code that requires fewer review iterations over time.
Build appropriate automated tests for the features you develop.
Work confidently with REST APIs and increasingly understand our real-time architecture.
Debug frontend and integration issues effectively.
Use AI tools to noticeably improve your development speed and productivity while maintaining engineering quality .
Participate meaningfully in technical discussions and code reviews.
Collaborate effectively with your squad and other engineering teams.
Become someone your teammates can rely on to own and finish work properly .

Develop reusable, maintainable, and scalable frontend components.
Turn product requirements and designs into clean, intuitive, and responsive user experiences.

d: KBR’s Sustainable Technology Solutions (STS) group is looking for a Project Engineer I for 5-year PMC contract for the supply of Programme Management services with Kuwait Oil Company. The contract serves to support KOC to achieve its objectives of reaching optimum capacity in its oilfields and enhancing its facilities by the most efficient and economical means available.

The contract aims to provide project management, co-ordination, planning, design, engineering, construction management, contracting, procurement, project controls and other services for construction of new oil field facilities, up-grading of existing facilities, and transfer of technology.
Management of support services for supervising and directing engineering, procurement and management of construction contractors appointed by the Client.
Management of services for Oil & Gas production activities including start-up and initial operations assistance as well as operational personnel and systems as required by the Client.

Manage and coordinate multidiscipline engineering activities to ensure projects such as FEED (front end engineering design) studies and preparation, ITB (invitation to bid) check estimate preparation, LSTK (lump sum turnkey) tender package preparation are executed in a safe, efficient, cost effective and timely manner.
Act as primary technical coordination interface with client to ensure that the client’s expectations are satisfied.
Ensure the project conforms to the client’s approved Basis of Design and all applicable regulatory and code requirements.
q: B. Sc. Eng from an accredited college or university.
10 years minimum experience post qualification in Oil & Gas, refinery, or petrochemical industry, with exposure to heavy oil projects
5 years of minimum experience in related designation / specialty.
Must have proven track record of managing and leading teams for large sized projects in the Oil & Gas industry
Must have experience in Kuwait , particularly in projects with Kuwait Oil Company
